newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end firm, following Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end firm, following Wall Street.

text.p: Caracas stocks rose in tandem with Wall Street as foreign investors returned to the market and blue chip stocks with American Depository Receipt (ADR) listings lead the rise, traders said.
"If it gets better there, it gets better here," said Profimerca broker Miguel Gonzalez.
The bolsa's leading 19-share index rose 0.94 percent to close at 6,230.24 points as 12.7 million shares traded, worth 2.7 billion bolivars ($5.6 million).
